Package com.esignal.jstandard.exception

Purpose of this package is to define all exceptions related to the JStandard API.

See: Description

  • Class Summary 
    Class Description
    ErrorCodes
    This class is used to hold the ErrorCodes for the custom Exceptions that are sent back from the API calls .
  • Enum Summary 
    Enum Description
    ErrorCodes.GREEKS_ERROR_CODES
    This enum is used to list the Error codes that can be returned while calculating the Greeks.
    ErrorCodes.NEWS_ERROR_CODES
    This enum is used to list the Error codes that can be returned while making a request, subscribe, unsubscribe or getStory call for the News Manager.
  • Exception Summary 
    Exception Description
    ConnectionException
    This exception will be thrown to handle problems while establishing or closing a connection.
    GreeksException
    This class is used to pass back meaningful exception messages and codes for the issue that was encountered during the calculation of the Greeks.
    InvalidDataConversionException
    This exception will be thrown if a value can not be converted to the specified type
    InvalidDataException
    This exception will be thrown if a there is an issue parsing the received data.
    NotSupportedException
    Not all ResourceManager resources has the same level of information which is reflected on their implementation.
    ResourceManagerException
    This exception will be thrown to handle problems while initializing or closing ResourceManager instaces.
